title: LATTE: Latent Trajectory Embedding for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection
usefulness_reason: Proposes LATTE, a novel approach modeling latent trajectory embeddings across multiple denoising steps for robust cross-generator detection.
key_findings: Modeling the sequential evolution of latent embeddings across multiple denoising steps reveals subtle and discriminative patterns.
LATTE achieves superior performance particularly in challenging cross-generator and cross-dataset scenarios.
research_problem: Addressing the limitation of existing approaches that rely on single-step reconstruction errors and overlook the sequential nature of the denoising process.
